summary: Show the birds heard by BirdNET-Go on your Mac or Linux computer.
page_description: See the birds BirdNET-Go hears on your computer, drawn as Fugleramme's labelled plates and sent to your Kobo. The last collage stays on screen offline.
release_notes: Clearer description and setup steps in the Store. No change to how the app works.

steps.text: Run BirdNET-Go and Fugleramme on a Mac or Linux computer with a microphone.
Enable SSH with kobo setup --enable-ssh, then start the companion on the computer.
